claim: r_3(3^k) >= 2^k for k=1..7, certified by independently verified 3-AP-free witnesses.

facets.mechanism: base-3 digit-restricted (no digit 2) construction avoids three-term progressions
facets.method: independently verified witness sets at powers of three
facets.outcome: lower bound 2^k at n=3^k confirmed to k=7
facets.entities: 3-AP-free subsets of the first n integers
